title: Ing Pamaglakbe ning Inampon a Kaladua
intro: keng panaun nung nukarin ding kaugalian ning lipunan ila ring mag-ari, ing metung a indibidwal menakit yang maragul a pamagbayu kilub ning metung a mapalad a pibale-bale. Ing karelang istorya, a mitatakan king metung a tali ning lugud at metung a banal a kautusan, papakit na ing pangasira da ring lumang tradisyun at ing pamagtatag karing bayu, matulid a prinsipyu. Ing salaysay ayni papakit na ing importansya ning katutwan kesa keng kumbensyun ampo ing kabiasnan keng likod da reng utus ning Allah.
clues: Minsan metung kung bihag, pero kapamilatan ning banal a pamag-ayus, menakit kung bayung tuknangan at pamilya.
kaluguran da ku inyang dininan da kung pilinan keng biological family ku ampo ing adopted guardian ku, pinili kung manatili keng tauli.
Ing lagyu ku misan makasuglung ya keng kanakung inampon a guardian, metung a gawi na karaniwan keng lipunan ku.
Aku mu ing kayabe ning tauling propeta na ing lagyu na malino neng sinabi ning Allah keng Quran.
Mekiasawa ku king metung a babaing marangal a pinsan ning Propeta, oneng e miglambat ing kekaming pamikaluguran.
Kaybat ning kanakung diborsyu, i Allah mismu ing mig-decrete na ing dating asawa ku makiasawa ya keng Propeta, at makanyan yang mewala ing minunang kaugalian tungkul keng pamag-ampon.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
